meta.title: NBA all-time top 100 — Owner-supplied
meta.source: Owner-supplied list pasted into the council session on 2026-10-21
meta.source_class: owner-supplied ratings (the pool still needs the Owner's final approval)

column_interpretation.ovr: the overall rating, as supplied (integers 93-99 in this list)
column_interpretation.three_point_shooting: INFERRED — the source's second number. The reading fits every case that can be checked against a known 2K-style profile: Shaq 26, Curry 99, Nash 94, Chris Paul 83, Brunson 86, Tony Parker 89, Wilt 43, Bird 98, Dirk 96, Jordan 83, Jokić 85, Durant 95; range 25-99.
column_interpretation.defence: INFERRED — the source's third number. Equally consistent: Shaq 98, Curry 36, Nash 25, Chris Paul 27, Brunson 35, Tony Parker 30, Wilt 85, Bird 45, Dirk 50, Jordan 95, Jokić 75, Durant 80; range 25-99.
column_interpretation.confirmation_needed: the two columns are labelled INFERRED, not VERIFIED — the Owner should confirm before the NBA pack depends on them, and the labels are in the file so a wrong guess is visible rather than baked in.

notes: These are PLAYER-SEASONS, not players: 100 rows cover 87 distinct people, and 10 people appear more than once (LeBron x3, Durant x3, Kawhi x3; Shaq, Kareem, Wilt, Erving, Oscar, Moses Malone and Anthony Davis x2). The Owner's direction says person identity and player-season stay distinct, and this list is the first real example of that split.
peak_year is null everywhere: the Owner's source carried peak years and she asked that they be discarded; the paste has no year column, so the team is peak-era context only.
Positions are given as a pair of slots (SG / SF, PG / N …) — position candidates for the draft, from the Owner. Country, height and Hall-of-Fame/badges are carried as context.

Canonical names restore the diacritics the paste dropped (Jokić, Şengün, Porziņģis, Buzeliņš, Vučević, Topić, Bogdanović, Valančiūnas, Nurkić, Schröder, Jović, Salaün, Traoré) and expand three nicknames to their legal names (Earvin "Magic" Johnson, Nathaniel "Nate" Archibald, John Alexander "Jo Jo" White).
